So, I will preface this with, I did enjoy this game for what it is, it's a zoo tycoon-type game with a premise I've been wanting to see for years upon years. It has a strong basis for that concept in a lot of places, but it does suffer from a lot, buggy zoo employee AI, a lot of enclosure design lacks depth and the terrain itself costs way too much to change, research also lacks a lot of more interesting elements.

Basically, the game has a lot of interesting base ideas but as it stands it feels more like a prototype proof-of-concept rather than a complete game.
Un charmant petit jeu de gestion ! Ca me rappelle un peu zoo tycoon (et autres jeux de gestion à l'ancienne.) L'esthétique "magie" est agréable, et j'aime voir mes bebêtes vaguabonder dans le zoo :3
This game is fun, good price for what you get. I love the concept of it. I am a sucker for zoo games, and this twist on it is really neat (:

I stumbled across this game while looking for other Zoo management type games to play and honestly the concept alone got me interested. A zoo full of mythical creatures sign me up! When I bought it and installed it for myself I noticed that it played a lot like Zoo tycoon 1 with better graphics and some added gameplay mechanics which got me even more excited for Early Access mode to be finished. I also like how they went all out with the medieval theming in this game. My only real issues with this game are the fact that it is rather bare Bones in its current state but I do understand that the game is still in Early Access end of the Zoo rating on the top right corner of the screen seems to fluctuate quite a lot, with a lot of guests leaving my Zoo just shortly after arriving complaining about lack of food and drink stands, outhouses, benches and entertainment. The last one especially confused me because there aren't really any entertainers that you can hire at least not yet, personally I think that being able to hire witches or warlocks perform magic tricks for guests would be a great addition to the game. While I don't think the game is perfect it plays just fine and it's really easy to get into, and in the concept of a zoo for fantasy creatures alone is enough for this game to potentially get very popular. Well it's not on the same level as other games like planet zoo or wildlife Park 3 it's still a good game and it's own right especially in its current state Early Access mode. Going to refund my purchase, as sadly the game suffers serious bugs when the developer has seemingly disappeared. A critical bug where animals literally waltz out of their enclosures through the gates as if they were staff. I encountered a version with only two animals in the demo but in the full release every single animal phases through gates.

I want to like this game really hard but it's not easy when it's broken. Zoo Tycoon 1 is my favorite game of all time but it's a bit upsetting the closest thing we've come to is an unfinished game.

I like the game. It's fun and simple to play. It reminds me of Zoo Tycoon. I like the music and the animals. There are a couple of issues with the game, but I think those will be solved soon.

Pros: 
Music

Great foundation for a magical zoo (I like the enclosure environments)

I like that the animals can break out and attack people and other animals (by far my favorite part)

The theme of a magical zoo

Cons:
It is bare bones right now with 15 animals and a small amount of entertainment and staff members (but I think this will be improved once the game is fully released)

There are a couple of glitches (for some reason, my dragons and my giants spiders keep teleporting into each other's enclosures) (also, the grounding crystal is having issues keeping my dragons inside their enclosure). Edit: I started a new game and these problems are no longer happening.

So far, there's no way to capture animals that have escaped 

All in all, I love the game and I'm glad that I bought it and I'm going to keep playing it for a couple more hours. Honestly, despite some of the early access issues, I'm having more fun with this game than I did with Planet Zoo for three main reasons. 1. It's quick and easy to set up enclosures 2. It reminds me of my childhood 3. I like the mythical animals. I can't wait for the full game to get released so I have more animals and more items to put in my zoo.

A promising game that brings me back to the times of Zoo Tycoon and Zoo Tycoon 2. While not much to do this early on in the game, a Dev did say they wish to expand the roster which gives me hope for various game modes, such as a campaign or something similar. The simplicity of this game could also leave a large opening for modding, which could grow a decent community. 

While zoo games are a dime a dozen in modern days, with Frontier leading the charge with Planet Zoo and the JW:E series, this one offers a whole new avenue for zoo games; Mythology, Cryptid and Fantasy Zoos (roll credits).

While it's fairly basic at the moment, the recent updates and dev communication does give me hope that this can grow and evolve into something wonderful. I wait to see what it can evolve into.

So this game is pretty glitchy - animals are forever getting stuck and not going to eat, drink etc even when the suitable elements are there in the enclosure. (If you pick them up and set them down again, they go straight to it.) 

I'm also a bit confused by the guests. They never seem to be happy no matter what. There are loads of animals to view, but their entertainment levels never seem to go up?

It's also not very intuitive to figure out what each animal needs. They have varying enclosure size requirements - small, medium or large - but the game doesn't give any indication as to what constitutes each size. How many squares on the grid is small, medium, or large? 

All of that said, the game is very cute, and it's fun to play. I'm going to keep it in the hope that the devs are still updating, as a few bug fixes and adjustments to guests etc would go a long way to elevate this game from like to love.

A short game of expanding your zoo of dangerous fantasy animals. I enjoyed figuring out every animal's personal needs and quirks, the setting is fun and filled with surprises. Also, the animals are cute.

I really would love to give this game a positive rating as it is a great concept and very interestingly done, and close to the Zoo Tycoon games plus the magical animals are a nice change, HOWEVER this game unfortunately is one buggy mess. Like, most of my creatures, weak or strong, escape the second I put down any gate, even very strong, heavy gates, or they don`t initially, but certainly will start escaping at some point later. Often times they also randomly escape through very strong barriers for some reason (NOT flying away, just walking through the fence), and lastly, and worst of all, recently all of my workers in one of my zoos lost their sanity altogether and went completely haywire; one of my goblin workers just started randomly attacking my rats when he was supposed to clean their enclosure and refill their food which he did do before without any issues, whilst most of the other workers simultaniously started experiencing some kind of long-term seizure which made them completely unable to walk anywhere to perform tasks (in large enclosures with more than enough space to walk). ALSO, most of the big, more aggressive creatures simply cannot be taken care of at all, as any goblin or human workers will simply be attacked and killed, meanwhile mage workers will always just immediately kill them which is very annoying. I love this game as a concept, however I simply cannot positively rate a game which seems that broken at this point.
